references.text: Encourages casting one's burden on the Lord, who will provide, paralleling the call not to worry about life's basic needs.
God encourages us not to fear, for He will strengthen and help, echoing the message of not worrying about life's necessities.
Encourages not being anxious about anything, but instead praying and giving thanks to God, who will grant peace, paralleling the call in Matthew not to worry.
Encourages being content with what one has and not loving money, which resembles the call not to worry about material needs.
